requirement.description: The Nextcloud plugin has an incorrect URL encoding issue in the url() method. When generating privacy URLs for user targets that contain @ symbols, the plugin incorrectly encodes them instead of properly prefixing with @.
requirement.contract: When generating privacy URLs for Nextcloud notifications, user targets should be properly prefixed with @ symbol in the URL path. For example, a target "user1" should appear as "@user1" in the privacy URL, not "%40user1". The URL encoding should not interfere with the @ prefixing logic.

requirement.description: The SendGrid plugin's send() method does not properly handle cases where targets are empty or invalid, causing it to return True instead of False when it should fail.
requirement.contract: When no valid targets are specified in a SendGrid notification, the send() method should return False to indicate failure. Currently it returns True even when no valid targets exist.

requirement.description: The Resend plugin's send() method does not properly handle cases where targets are empty or invalid, causing it to return True instead of False when it should fail.
requirement.contract: When no valid targets are specified in a Resend notification, the send() method should return False to indicate failure. Currently it returns True even when no valid targets exist.

requirement.description: The Nextcloud plugin's url() method incorrectly handles the encoding of user targets when they are already prefixed with @ in the targets list.
requirement.contract: User targets in Nextcloud URLs should be properly prefixed with @ for privacy URLs, regardless of whether they already start with @ in the original targets list. The URL encoding should not interfere with the @ prefixing logic.

requirement.description: The Apprise API details() method is not properly checking for required template configuration fields when building plugin details, leading to missing requirements information.
requirement.contract: The details() method should properly validate and include all required template configuration fields for each plugin. When a plugin lacks required template fields, the method should correctly identify and report this in the requirements section.
